shared_contract.identity: Alder Reach wordmark, one plain navigator, thin rule, and clearly fictional fixture voice.
shared_contract.navigation: Ten destination labels remain in the same relative order with current-page state and a first-focus skip link.
shared_contract.truth: Every statement is visibly labeled fictional fixture copy; no outside place, person, metric, or endorsement is implied.
shared_contract.accessibility: Semantic landmarks, logical headings, keyboard links, visible focus, reflow, and source-visible content are shared.
shared_contract.voice: Concrete observational English; route cadence may change but invented quotations and authority claims are prohibited.
shared_contract.performance: Local HTML and CSS are the complete baseline; enhancements may not block navigation or content.

routes.title: Alder Reach: ten ways in
routes.user_job: Understand the anthology and choose a useful route.

observable_decisions.decision: Present the supplied route choices as the main body rather than hiding them behind a generic promotional introduction.
observable_decisions.reason: The reader's immediate job is to understand the available documents and choose one.
observable_decisions.evidence: index.html and its ten direct destination links.

routes.responsive_result: The supplied ledger becomes one continuous numbered reading column while labels and destinations remain complete.
routes.reduced_motion_result: The cover is an identical static document.
routes.no_javascript_result: The complete contents and ordinary links remain available.
deliberate_differences: Cover prioritizes discovery rather than logistics.
Cover exposes the route ledger before the short note; Visit groups preparation information.

routes.no_javascript_result: Both plans and every dated event remain visible.
deliberate_differences: Timeline organizes evidence by date; Night Walk follows a supplied sensory route.
